description: Attestation that a human worker, displaced from a specific ISCO occupation by an etzhayyim OSS-robotics actor (sanae/hataori/kiyome/...), is registered for the tenure-weighted Displacement Dividend per ADR-2606032130. The dividend is delivered as in-kind Basic High Income (imputed income + commons-asset access) along the Liberation Ladder (ADR-2605261000 / ADR-2605301020), funded by the displacing actor's surplus-donation routed through TitheRouter (ADR-2605192130) into a per-cohort Public Fund earmark, and gated by the universal conversion covenant (ADR-2605302357). PII IS 要配慮 (tenure, occupation, hazard, prior-livelihood imputation): this record carries ONLY non-identifying fields plus an encrypted-envelope ref; per-person figures are NEVER published, only aggregate-per-cohort. cashStipendUsdMicros is a structural const-0 field — its presence is the on-chain proof N1 (cash≡0) holds (ADR-2605301020 §5).

subjectDid.description: DID of the displaced worker (did:web / did:plc / did:key). Once the worker enters the conversion covenant, this is their Adherent SBT-bound DID; pre-covenant it is an outreach DID.

cohortId.description: Displacement cohort id = hash(displacingActorDid + displacedIscoCode + regionCode + period). All members of a cohort share one tenure-weighted pool. Free of PII.

displacingActorDid.description: DID of the OSS-robotics actor whose deployment displaced this labour (e.g. did:web:etzhayyim.com:actor:sanae). The actor's surplus-donation funds this cohort's pool (G2 coupling, ADR-2606032100).

displacedIscoCode.description: ISCO-08 code of the displaced occupation (e.g. '6111' field-crop grower, '7531' garment maker, '9112' building cleaner). Drives the hazard class and the gap measurement.

displacedUnspscSegment.description: Optional UNSPSC 2-digit segment of the displaced product/service line (e.g. '70' farming, '53' apparel, '76' cleaning).

tenureMonths.description: Verified months of service in the displaced occupation (勤続年数 × 12). Capped at 600 (TENURE_CAP = 40 years) by the allocator. Drives w_i = ln(1 + min(tenure, cap)) × hazard.

tenureEvidenceRef.description: Optional AT URI of the encrypted tenure-evidence envelope (employer record / peer-witness quorum / self-attest+sample-audit). Encrypted per ADR-2605181100; never plaintext.

hazardClassPermille.description: Drudgery/danger class of the displaced occupation in per-mille (1000 = 1.0 baseline, 2000 = 2.0 max for the most hazardous ISCO lines: forestry/meat-processing/fishing). Council-attested methodology; integer-with-implied-units (ADR-2605190900).

priorLivelihoodImputedUsdMicrosYr.description: OPTIONAL imputed market-equivalent annual value of the worker's prior livelihood, in USDC micros/yr (NOT cash paid — an in-kind valuation used only to set the transition floor, itself capped at the Ladder stage ceiling so it cannot pull a higher commons standard than the Ladder provides). Encrypted/aggregate-only.

ladderStage.description: Current Liberation Ladder stage of the worker (L0..L6) per ADR-2605261000. The dividend governs onboarding priority within a stage's capacity cap and the in-kind transition floor, never a cash split.

covenantStatus.description: Conversion-covenant status (ADR-2605302357 §1.16.3). 'outreach' = invited, minimal transition floor only; 'vowed' = triple-permanent vow recorded (kotoba+IPFS+SBT), full tenure-weighted dividend applies.

cashStipendUsdMicros.description: INVARIANT, always 0. The Displacement Dividend is delivered in-kind (imputed income + commons-asset access), never as cash. Presence of this const-0 field is the on-chain proof that N1 (cash≡0) holds (ADR-2605301020 §5).

poolPolicyRef.description: Optional AT URI of the Public-Fund-voted cohort pool policy (size + tenure-weight params + hazard table version) this attestation complies with (ADR-2605192145 propose/vote/timelock).
